Claw.Inflict Fear: If rolled 8, the target chooses to either be Clawed again or get a Phobia Negative Quirk.

Bite.Blood Fever: The target becomes Silenced (it can't use Abilities).

Passives.Blood Rush:
As soon as the Skinwalker drops to/below 50% HP, it can make a free Move Act and a free Bite (even during other Units' turns).
Then, the other Unit can continue its Turn.

Passives.Shapeshift & Mimickry:
While at least 10 meters away from an observer, the Skinwalker can shapeshift into any animal or person they have seen, and can mimick any voice or sound.
The closer you get to a Skinwalker, the more apparent it seems that the transformation is disfigured and uncanny.

Skinwalker.Behavior:
When dropping to 50% HP, they can run towards the back line of the party and bite them!
If healthy, Gnolls employ tactics like kiting, flanking, etc.
If below 50% HP, Gnolls go wild!
Skinwalker.Monster Data: No tactic, mid HP, no gimmick

Dazzling Wave.Effect:
Create a long, tall wall of light from one end of the battlefield to another.
Enemies touching it take {DamageAoEAuto} Divine Damage and are Single-Stunned.
Dazzling Wave.Notes: The wall is transparent, like a window, and does not provide Cover.

Rays.Effect:
The first time this is used, Players choose 2 targets.
If opposing, they take {DamageAoEAuto} Fire Damage and are Blinded. Otherwise, Heal them for {Damage1} and they gain +1 Action Point next (or current) Turn.
The 2 targets each choose one of the next targets for the upcoming Rays.

Abilities.Lightspawns:
Summon 1d4 flying orbs near the Seraph each that will target a different enemy.
Orbs have 1 Health and have 3 meters Speed.
Each orb chases one Hero. Upon collision, it explodes and damages it for {DamageAoEAuto} Damage.

Abilities.Feather Barrage:
Attack all Units in a 4x4 area for {DamageAoE} Pierce Damage.
Forms a "[" of caltrops on the ground, towards the Seraph.

Sword Attack.Blade of Remembrance: Target _remembers_ one of their used Abilities of choice.

Passives.Oblivion: After someone makes an attack with a weapon or uses an Ability, it can't be used anymore for the rest of the combat. Weapons vanish into thin air and Abilities are _forgotten_. Default Moves don't count.

Seraph.Monster Data: No tactic, mid HP, no gimmick
